title: Clean up
searchInTip: Cleaning up also goes through every subfolder.
toTrash: What is deleted goes to the trash
capped: There are more finds than listed here. After cleaning up, a new run shows the rest.

kept.one: {n} name is taken already and stays as it is
kept.other: {n} names are taken already and stay as they are

emptyDir.label: Empty folders
emptyDir.tip: Folders without files. A folder holding only empty folders counts as well.

temp.label: Leftovers
temp.tip: Broken off downloads such as .part and .!qB, Office lock files with ~$ and what macOS and Windows leave in folders.

ext.label: Wrong ending
ext.tip: The content does not fit the ending, such as a PNG called .jpg. Cleaning up gives it the right ending.

name.label: Troublesome names
name.tip: Names that do not work on Windows over SMB or cause trouble. Cleaning up replaces the characters with _ and takes spaces off the edges.
